assign.layer: Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics

newLayers.name: Core Configuration Entries
newLayers.description: Where the spark.* settings of core are defined: the ConfigBuilder based entries with their keys, defaults and documentation in the internal.config package (the main package object and per area files for deploy, history server, Kryo, network, Python, R, status, streaming and tests), plus the provider that reads them from SparkConf.

appendDesc.Spark UI, Status Store and Metrics: Also covers the concrete metrics sinks (servlet, Prometheus servlet, StatsD, SLF4J) and sources (JVM, JVM CPU, accumulators, static sources).

tour.title: Where spark.* settings are defined
tour.description: Core settings are not read as bare strings: each one is declared once as a ConfigEntry with ConfigBuilder, giving its key, type, default and documentation. The big package object in internal.config holds most entries, and separate files group the entries for deploy, the history server, Kryo, network, Python, R and the status store. SparkConf reads values through these entries.
